preconditions.description: The contract must have a positive ETH balance (or the attacker must be able to deposit ETH to create a balance)
The attacker must be able to call multiSendETH with a malicious contract as one of the recipients

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract with a fallback/receive function that re-enters the multiSendETH function. Call multiSendETH with the malicious contract as a recipient and a small amount. In the fallback, re-enter multiSendETH before the totalAmount check, causing the contract to send more ETH than the msg.value. The attack drains ETH from the contract balance.
